app.name: Expert GPS Tracking

playStore.releaseNotes: Initial release: Complete fleet management system with Driver, User, Admin, and Super Admin dashboards

driver.description: Driver interface for real-time route tracking and trip management

user.description: Student/User interface for tracking pickup and dropoff status

admin.description: Organization admin dashboard for fleet management

superAdmin.description: Super admin dashboard for system-wide management

accessFineLocation.reason: Required for GPS tracking and location services
